selection: Filter the same 551 selected orders at confirmation; no replacement or new entry delay; replay portfolio allocation.

stock_confirmation.vwap: Incremental-volume-weighted HLC3 from 09:16 through the completed confirmation minute.
stock_confirmation.support_resistance: Lowest low / highest high of the three exact completed one-minute bars immediately before confirmation; confirmation close must break strictly.
stock_confirmation.main_rule: Primary index veto AND stock on adverse side of session VWAP AND adverse support/resistance break.

persistence.rule: Primary index veto AND every one of the last N same-session completed five-minute candle bodies opposes the trade.
persistence.insufficient_opening_history: Retain the current primary-index veto until N same-session completed candles exist.

volatility.measure: Mean true range of preceding 14 same-session completed five-minute index candles, excluding the current candle, divided by previous close, as a percentage.
volatility.rule: Both adverse slot and session percentage moves must strictly exceed multiplier times prior ATR percentage.
volatility.insufficient_opening_history: Retain the current primary-index veto until five prior candles exist.

combination_rule: All named conditions must hold to veto. Combine main stock confirmation, two-candle persistence, and 0.5 ATR threshold in each pair and all three.

walk_forward.selection: Among variants with training loss amount, losing days and daily-close drawdown no worse than the Nifty reference, choose highest training net profit. Nifty reference is an eligible fallback. Freeze choice before the next block.
walk_forward.caveat: All dates have previously been researched; chronological evaluation is diagnostic, not an untouched holdout.

promotion: No strategy default or latest baseline pointer changes; user selects a policy after reviewing results.
